purpose: Move SolQvia from architecture-building into measurement, visual QA, real-device execution, and evidence-to-SEO feedback while preventing planned/unmeasured work from being reported as completed.

gates.objective: Recompute Phase145/153 priorities and post-change impact from newer raw Search Console exports.
gates.pass_condition: A newer raw export is available and processed without inferring Query×Page joins from separate tables.
gates.next_action: When a new SolQvia GSC export is available, run the existing Phase153 measurement path before changing search-demand priorities.
forbidden_claims: Do not call the 2026-09-08 baseline current demand.
Do not claim ranking/CTR uplift without newer raw data.
Do not create device-level GSC rankings from absent query data.

gates.objective: Distinguish current repository/public implementation from search-engine crawl freshness.

current_state.interpretation: The repository implementation is current while the searchable crawl snapshot is stale; this is not enough evidence to call deployment broken.

gates.pass_condition: A later search-engine crawl exposes Phase163 and the 572 search count, or equivalent current-page markers.
gates.next_action: Monitor re-crawl/index freshness; do not roll back main or add duplicate content solely to chase a stale crawl snapshot.
forbidden_claims: Do not call a stale crawl snapshot a deployment failure without live-origin evidence.
Do not reduce the canonical dataset from 572 to match a stale 550 snapshot.

gates.objective: Verify the Phase163 three-layer Device Passport at real breakpoints and interaction states.
gates.pass_condition: All required breakpoint/scenario combinations are visually reviewed with no clipping, overlap, unreadable density, or misleading hierarchy.
gates.next_action: Run browser screenshots when an environment with page rendering is available; store only QA results, not user data.
forbidden_claims: Static CSS validation is not visual QA.
Do not mark responsive layout as visually passed until rendered.

gates.objective: Execute Phase164 capture campaigns using actual devices/lines and Phase162 privacy-safe capture format.
gates.pass_condition: At least one Phase164 plan becomes a validated Phase162 completed capture with explicit observed values and passed privacy review.
gates.next_action: When a device/line is physically available, start with the Phase164 generated blank capture and record only actual observations.
forbidden_claims: A planned campaign is not a real-device test.
Do not copy Y!mobile results into SoftBank scope or vice versa.
Do not infer current software behavior from a historical unbound capture.

gates.objective: Feed validated SolQvia-owned runtime evidence back into existing high-value URLs without expanding page count unnecessarily.

current_state.reason: No new Phase164 capture has been completed yet.

gates.pass_condition: A validated capture is reflected into the relevant existing page as static crawlable evidence with exact scope/date/software conditions.
gates.next_action: After capture validation, update the existing URL first, then measure GSC impact before considering a new URL.
forbidden_claims: Do not publish planned runtime results.
Do not create a new URL only because a new capture exists.
Do not convert a scoped runtime result into a device-wide compatibility guarantee.

operating_order: Acquire and measure newer GSC raw data when available.
Execute KY-41C continuation capture when the physical test setup is available.
Execute SCG36/au deep capture when available.
Reflect validated evidence into existing static SEO surfaces.
Measure impact before adding more architecture or URLs.
